turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start baking bread at home and I have a few ways to begin.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a simple no knead loaf that rises overnight and bakes in a heavy pot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is starting a sourdough starter, which takes about a week before I can even bake.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could just buy a bread machine that does everything for me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do you want to learn baking, or mostly just have fresh bread? If you want to learn, start with the no knead loaf and move to sourdough later. If you just want bread, the machine is fine.
